name: akita-accounts
description: Connect Cursor to Akita ARC-58 agent wallets — payments, staking, DAO, social, and marketplace actions via MCP, plus curated skills for wallet and plugin development.

ENV_FILE.title: Path to agent wallet .env
ENV_FILE.description: Absolute path to the .env file generated by the Akita agent-wallet setup wizard (npx @akta/agent-wallet-cli / pnpm setup). Contains Intermezzo/Vault credentials, WALLET_APP_ID, and ESCROW_NAME.
